newer_changes_search: Web search (2026-10-26): no change to PM-KMY in 2025-2026 and no merger with PM-SYM. The PIB explainer of 11 Sep 2026 (already cited) confirms the current terms: 18-40, up to 2 ha, land records as on 1 Aug 2019, Rs 3,000 pension, Rs 55-200 contribution.

findings.note: The rule text says 'not in PM-SYM or PM-LVM', but the field question (has_formal_pension_cover) asks only about EPF, ESIC, NPS or another government pension. PM-SYM/PM-LVM subscribers may answer 'no'.
findings.suggestion: Make the rule text match the field ('Not covered by EPF, ESIC or NPS, and gets no other government pension'), and mention PM-SYM/PM-LVM in how_to_apply.

findings.note: The field family_has_govt_job also includes 'a pension of ₹10,000 or more a month', which is a PM-KISAN exclusion and not in the PM-KMY explainer. In practice it barely changes results (retired employees are excluded anyway).
Marked mandatory, but the PIB explainer says enrolment is 'paperless' with Aadhaar, bank details and mobile only. Land-record checks are done by the state.
maandhan.in is the Labour Ministry's Maandhan portal. Its snapshot is about PM-SYM and NPS-Traders, not PM-KMY. The explainer cites pmkmy.gov.in.
findings.suggestion: Use https://pmkmy.gov.in/ as official_apply_url and snapshot it.
